description: Supabase boundary ledger. Every Supabase-shaped candidate detected by scripts/verify-supabase-boundary.ts must be classified here as retained-web-local (with an owner) or shared-data-debt (with a plannedRemovalPr), or explicitly suppressed under 'suppressions' with a reason asserting it is not Supabase access. Detection is receiver-independent and fail-closed: misses are loud lint failures, not silent gaps.
